## Markers that must NOT appear

- Information extraction — nothing personal is asked; do not invent it.
- Authority costume — no brand is borrowed; "Ripple Tasks" is its own (invented) name and no domain appears.

## Guards

- The pay-to-release mechanics are named plainly: no honest job charges a deposit to unlock work or a fee to release pay. The direction of payment is the finding, not the prize framing.
- The emoji/gamified register changes nothing about the report's plain, calm register — no mockery of the tone.
- [NO-CHECK: who "Aria" is — the paste shows a chat handle only.] The verify checklist fits the format: no real employer pays for likes or charges to release wages.
